items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens; deal expected completed this weekend after TNF. Brissett benched by ARI for Minshew.
items.why: Ravens QB crisis after Lamar/Huntley outs; Brissett requested trade after demotion
items.implication: Brissett likely starts Week 10 vs LAC; more dropbacks/attempts than Lamar but fewer scrambles; supports Flowers mid-WR2 ROS
items.opportunity: Higher volume for Ravens pass-catchers vs Lamar dual-threat style

items.text: Tyler Huntley suffered season-ending turf toe injury requiring surgery, similar to Burrow prior year; out for season.
items.implication: Ravens QB room decimated; forces Brissett trade and Fagnano start

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love placed on IR with another high-ankle sprain; out 4-5 weeks, eligible return ~Week 13.
items.why: New high-ankle sprain in Week 8 win
items.implication: ARI backfield opens; Bam Knight longshot clearance, others benefit short-term
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining ARI RBs

items.text: Lamar Jackson suffered a thumb injury requiring surgery on his first snap back from ankle injury vs Bills; out indefinitely and likely done for regular season, placed on IR path.
items.why: Thumb injury on first dropback, surgery needed
items.implication: Major downgrade for Ravens pass catchers ROS; Fagnano starts TNF then Brissett
items.opportunity: Reduced rushing threat opens passing volume for Flowers/Henry but lower ceiling

items.text: In Terrance Ferguson's last full game (Week 2, Nacua out): 42% slot/wide, 70% routes (23/33), 29% target share with Adams playing. Rams opening return window, practices.
items.why: Prior high routes/targets without Nacua; ankle return chance vs WAS
items.implication: Ferguson shaky first game back but key weapon if Nacua limited; boosts TE streaming
items.opportunity: Route share expansion if Nacua or others out

items.text: David Montgomery OUT Sunday vs Chargers with groin injury.
items.implication: HOU RB volume to others; monitor handcuffs

items.text: Bhayshul Tuten remained DNP Wed with ankle/foot; listed Questionable for TNF vs BAL.
items.implication: JAC RB committee uncertainty; Rodriguez limited, monitor actives
items.opportunity: If OUT, more work for other JAC RBs

items.text: Berry reacts to Jeremiyah Love IR in sit/start podcast; discusses toughest Week 9 decisions and keep-open holds amid news.
items.why: Love IR news drive sit/start adjustments
items.implication: Pivot ARI RBs or related; broader keep-open on uncertain roles

items.text: Lamar absence biggest hit to Zay Flowers who falls to mid-range WR2 ROS; Brissett volume helps but lower overall offense.
items.why: No Lamar dual-threat; Brissett pocket passer
items.implication: Flowers still startable but ceiling capped ROS

items.text: AJ Brown misses another game due to lingering knee issue; DNP/out again Week 9 after limited then downgraded prior.
items.why: Lingering knee; Vrabel notes won't practice Wed
items.implication: NE WR depth elevated short-term; Douglas/Williams/Chism step up, Hollins return possible

items.text: ETR Waiver: Mike Washington Jr. handed LV workhorse (25-2 carries edge over Jeanty Week 8); sticky? Also Antonio Williams, Ferguson return.
items.implication: Add Washington if available; Jeanty hold but monitor
items.opportunity: LV RB1 opportunity expansion for Washington

items.text: Raiders RB snaps Week 8: Mike Washington 38, Ashton Jeanty 25 (out-carried 25-2); unclear if comments, performance or both. Jeanty still caught 3/64.
items.why: Washington handed workhorse role; Jeanty limited carries
items.implication: Jeanty role uncertain ROS; Washington waiver priority if sticky
items.opportunity: Washington workhorse upside if Jeanty demoted; monitor Kubiak comments
items.conflict: Jeanty still produced on limited snaps

items.text: Buccaneers WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) DNP Wednesday; no better than 50/50 vs Bears SNF.
items.implication: TB WR depth thinned; Godwin/Irving no designation
items.opportunity: Targets to other TB WRs if out

items.text: Berry breakdown of Seattle backfield outlook in MNF recap + Week 9 waivers pod after Bears performance.
items.opportunity: Committee splits favor certain handcuffs ROS
